message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false)","note":"The fuzz target accepts raw attacker bytes as a frame buffer, so a crafted .b2frame payload can reach frame parsing and chunk reconstruction."},
{"step":2,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"get_header_info","line":365,"var":"frame->cframe or file header","code":"parse frame header fields such as frame_len, cbytes, chunksize, and frame type","note":"The header parser derives the logical frame layout from attacker-controlled bytes and rejects only grossly inconsistent values."},
{"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"get_coffset","line":1706,"var":"coffsets","code":"coffsets = get_coffsets(frame, header_len, cbytes, &off_cbytes)","note":"Chunk offsets are then computed from the frame trailer/offset table, so malformed offsets can steer later lazychunk construction."},
{"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1877,"var":"offset","code":"rc = get_coffset(frame, header_len, cbytes, nchunk, &offset)","note":"The lazychunk builder uses the attacker-influenced chunk offset and decides whether to build a synthetic heap chunk or borrow an in-memory pointer."},
{"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1952,"var":"*chunk","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes); *needs_free = true;","note":"For file-backed / non-contiguous cases, the function allocates a temporary lazychunk buffer and marks it for cleanup by the caller."},
{"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":null,"var":"src","code":"frame_decompress_chunk consumes the lazychunk and frees it on the needs_free path","note":"The vulnerability surface is in ownership cleanup: malformed frame metadata can make the chunk path hand a freed/borrowed pointer to later cleanup, producing an invalid free."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
print('ok')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json | python3 -c 'import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin); print("trace valid json")'
